checks.detail: Engine authority is 6.4.0 while Project Format 2/schema 29 remain frozen.
Aseprite frames, texture, timing and tags import into canonical atlas data.
Frame reordering preserves stable source-key identities.
Fractional pivots and collider coordinates survive canonical import.
TexturePacker and common atlas variants normalize correctly.
Tiled JSON/XML normalize layers, empty cells and default opacity.
Malformed XML, oversized metadata and unsupported extensions fail closed.
A local Resource override stores one local key and resolves inherited defaults.
Resource serialization is deterministic and does not expand local overrides.
Resource inheritance cycles fail closed and produce build-visible diagnostics.
Bounded auto-weights normalize every vertex and feed the skin-weight heat view.
Retarget preview identifies mapped and missing aliases before playback.
Root-motion preview uses the runtime sampler and reports exact motion.
Large atlas and timeline operations remain within explicit local release budgets.
Dedicated contextual Asset tabs and production animation controls are connected.
The compact Asset menu has distinct bounded controls, reactive metadata crosses a JSON clone boundary and hidden controls retain real labels.
Resource validation and content inclusion reach cycle-safe, bounded native/Web package paths.
New Asset and animation controls are translated in English, German and Chinese.
The authoritative checkpoint and task-oriented content/animation guide are present.
